title: Overlay
description: Claims about a row of a dataset (docs/STRUCTURE.md section 3.1). A record cannot be written into a dataset, so an overlay names a row as its subject, src:<dataset>#<key>, and corrects it (a competing claim ranked preferred, with a note saying why), corroborates it (the same value from another source), or ties it to the entity it is (same_as). The row stays as the dataset gives it. One file per row.

row.description: The row: its dataset and its key, as the inspect panel gives it

author.description: The author of this file's claims, unless a claim says otherwise

same_as.description: The entity this row is a row of: a record that adopts it
